## Highlights

- Added browser media session playback support alongside existing TIDAL detection
- Added provider-based source selection, cooldown handling, browser debug visibility, and browser settings controls
- Improved overlay and app fallback behavior for low-quality browser metadata and missing artwork

## Included browser support

- Chrome
- Edge
- Firefox
- Best-effort metadata handling for YouTube, YouTube Music, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, and generic browser playback

## Notes

- Bandcamp support remains best effort because metadata quality depends on what the browser exposes to Windows media sessions
- This release also raises automated test coverage to the repo quality gates and updates the README for the current release workflow
